title: Private Oahu Circle Island Tour (up to 14 people)
requirements: Infants are required to sit on an adult’s lap
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
{$92/person+} Join us on a personalized Oahu, Hawaii experience! Explore beautiful spots like Dole Plantation, Haleiwa Town, Halona Blow Hole, and cruise along the North Shore, and check out the world-famous Surf Breaks. Have the freedom to do whatever you like at your own pace! 

We specialize in small groups from 1 to 14 people. 
All of our tours are 100% flexible. With a Local professional tour guide.

We put lots of ALOHA into ensuring you make the most of your precious time here in the beautiful state of Hawaii. 

Mahalo nui loa! = Thank you very much!
